title: One reduction, then four output coordinates
purpose: Follow every square and partial sum before broadcasting the reciprocal RMS.
contract: x [4] and learned w [4] are immutable; epsilon = 1e-5 is inside the root.
Products, sums and output are F32; y [4] has canonical owned storage.
